messages:
monica_ae: Heads up — Solstice Medical CTO just escalated. They say we need a formal crypto attestation (FIPS/HSM proof + TLS rotation process + confirmation of SOC2 scope) before exec signoff. POC hold until we produce it.
ryan_se: Can you paste their exact ask from the email?
monica_ae: Quote from CTO: "Provide third-party or engineer-signed attestation showing KMS/HSM mode, key lifecycle (rotation), and TLS cert rotation SOP. We need this by EOD Wed to avoid delaying procurement."
lina_sec: We don't have our own FIPS stamp. We rely on cloud KMS FIPS/HSM modules. We can assemble an attestation referencing provider certs + how our deployment uses CMKs/HSM-backed keys. Also can include architecture diagram and redacted logs demonstrating key usage.
andrew_eng: We can produce a short implementation appendix and a sample config. Example snippet for the attestation appendix:
```
kms_config:
  provider: cloudkms
  mode: hsm
  key_ring: projects/redwood-poc/locations/global/keyRings/poc
  crypto_key: poc-key-1 (redacted in final)
  rotation: 90d
```
ryan_se: Timeline? CTO asked for deliverable by EOD Wednesday, that's tight.
carl_vp_sales: This is an exec-level escalation. Monica, escalate to legal & solutions. I'll join the customer call. Hold the SOW signoff until we have the attestation or a contractual mitigation.
lina_sec: I'll draft a one-page attestation (v0.1) that: references cloud provider FIPS/HSM documentation, explains our KMS integration, includes TLS cert rotation SOP bullets, and links to SOC2 scope. Need infra to confirm exact key identifiers used in the POC env.
andrew_eng: POC key details (internal): projects/redwood-poc/locations/global/keyRings/poc/cryptoKeys/poc-key-1 — we can redact full name in public doc. Confirmed HSM mode enabled in prod and POC via cloudkms. Rotation policy: automated 90d.
monica_ae: I'll DM the customer's original thread to the group. @ryan_se please schedule a quick sync with Solstice CTO + @lina_sec + @carl_vp_sales for tomorrow 10:00am PST. Add legal: legal@redwood (for visibility).
ops_bot: POC env provisioned in us-west1 (g4dn-equivalent). Resource link: https://console.redwood/pocs/solstice/12345. Logs/metrics accessible to redwood-sec-role.
lina_sec: Draft attestation uploaded: https://drive.redwood/attestations/solstice-v0-1 (internal). Requesting signoff from @carl_vp_sales and @andrew_eng before we send to the customer.
carl_vp_sales: Reviewing v0.1 now. If the customer insists on a third-party FIPS certificate we need to add a contract clause + pricing delta (HSM-only commit). Otherwise we can provide attestation + provider certs.
ryan_se: I'll prepare a pricing delta for HSM-only mode: preliminary numbers — +$0.12 per 1k tokens for HSM ops + an estimated $2k/mo reserved HSM overhead for POC scale. I'll put exact figures in the meeting.
monica_ae: Action items summary: Lina finalize attestation, Andrew confirm/redact key config, Ryan prepare pricing delta, Carl to join customer call and approve contract language if needed, Monica to schedule call. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
